note: Both sets capture the same core facts: grade level at 0'-0" and finished floor at 2'-9 1/2" (2'-9 1/2" above grade) for both the East and West Module sections, with quotes that support the claims. Set A adds a redundant, condition-less grade level claim that is trivial duplication of its other claims. Set B avoids that duplication but renders the grade elevation as '0 ft', a unit conversion not stated in the quoted text (0' - 0"). Each set has one minor defect and otherwise equivalent coverage and binding accuracy.
